name: ToolFlexy MediaFix – Image Optimizer, WebP/AVIF & Media Cleaner
author: toolflexy

sections.description:
Make your WordPress images faster, cleaner, and more SEO-friendly without depending on an external image-processing service.

ToolFlexy MediaFix gives bloggers, publishers, WooCommerce stores, agencies, and content creators one organized dashboard for image optimization, missing ALT text, WebP/AVIF conversion, duplicate detection, and conservative media cleanup.

Add Missing Image ALT Text Faster

Stop opening every image and writing ALT text manually. MediaFix audits your Media Library, finds images with missing ALT attributes, and creates relevant suggestions from the content already available on your website.

Depending on the image and your selected settings, suggestions can use:

  • The related post or page title.
  • The WooCommerce product title.
  • An SEO focus keyword.
  • A cleaned image filename.
  • Your reusable ALT text templates.

MediaFix recognizes focus-keyword metadata from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, and common AIOSEO configurations. Preview suggestions before applying them, update missing ALT text individually or in batches, preserve existing ALT text, skip decorative images, and roll back recent changes.

Optimize JPG and PNG Images

Compress new uploads automatically or optimize existing JPG and PNG images through a controlled queue. Choose image quality and maximum dimensions, review an image before starting a bulk operation, keep original backups, and see the space saved for each image.

Convert Images to WebP or AVIF

Create modern WebP and AVIF versions of JPG and PNG images directly on your WordPress server when the installed GD or Imagick library supports them.

MediaFix can deliver a modern format through a responsive picture element while keeping the original image as a fallback. No external cloud account, API key, monthly quota, or per-image processing allowance is required for local image processing.

Review and Clean Your Media Library

Find exact duplicate files using file hashes and review potentially unused media without immediately deleting anything. MediaFix checks common references, featured images, content, page-builder data, product galleries, custom fields, and site-branding images.

Cleanup remains review-first: attachments are moved to WordPress Trash only after an authorized user confirms the action. MediaFix never permanently deletes cleanup candidates automatically.

One Media Dashboard

See media health, optimization progress, format distribution, storage savings, missing ALT text, recommended actions, recent activity, scheduled tasks, and server capabilities from one dashboard.

Key Features

  • Missing ALT text audit with previews, filters, batch processing, progress, and rollback.
  • ALT suggestions from post titles, page titles, product titles, focus keywords, cleaned filenames, and templates.
  • Support for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, and common AIOSEO keyword metadata.
  • Automatic optimization for new uploads and controlled optimization for existing images.
  • Configurable JPEG/PNG quality and maximum image dimensions.
  • WebP and AVIF sidecar generation when supported by the server.
  • Responsive modern-format delivery with the original image as a fallback.
  • Randomized-path original backups and file restoration.
  • Exact duplicate detection using file hashes.
  • Conservative unused-media review with reference and site-branding protection.
  • Selective thumbnail-size management for future uploads.
  • Media Collections for organizing attachments.
  • Media health reports, analytics, schedules, and recommended actions.
  • Server checks for WebP, AVIF, GD, Imagick, and upload-directory support.
  • Local processing with no mandatory account, license key, tracking, or usage limit.

Optional ToolFlexy Connect

The plugin includes an optional, disabled-by-default connection. Nothing is sent unless an administrator explicitly selects “Share installation data” and connects the site.

When enabled, ToolFlexy receives the site URL, site title, WordPress/PHP versions, MediaFix version, locale, and connection status. The administrator email is sent only when the separate marketing checkbox is selected. Users can disconnect and request deletion from MediaFix > ToolFlexy Connect.

Service: https://toolflexy.com/

Privacy: https://toolflexy.com/privacy-policy/

Important Safety Note

Make a full backup and test on a staging site before bulk optimization or cleanup. A scanner cannot guarantee that dynamically referenced media is unused.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate ToolFlexy MediaFix.
  3. Open MediaFix > System Status and confirm that uploads are writable.
  4. Review Settings, then optimize one test image before starting a bulk operation.
sections.faq:
Does it use an external image service?

No. It uses the image libraries available through WordPress on your own server.

Will AVIF always be available?

No. AVIF and WebP creation depends on your hosting server’s GD or Imagick capabilities. MediaFix reports this in System Status.

Does the cleaner delete files automatically?

No. It only shows conservative candidates. A user with deletion permission must review and move an attachment to Trash.

Does it overwrite existing ALT text?

The default is missing-only mode. Existing ALT text is preserved. Preview and rollback are also available.
